newsitem.title: USA: Genome Therapeutics hits testing milestone.
newsitem.headline: Genome Therapeutics hits testing milestone.

text.p: Genome Therapeutics said it has achieved the third milestone in its alliance with Astra Ab's Astra Research Center of Boston to test drugs for H. pylori, a bacterium asscoiated with gastrointestinal diseases.
Genome said it and Astra have begun high-throughput (rapid) screening for drug candidates that target a weakness in the genetic make-up of the H. pylori organism that the two organizations found.
The dollar amount of the milestone payment was not disclosed.
